name: Send SMS OTP
description: Send OTP code via SMS for authentication

container.description: Session cargo container for OTP storage

language.description: Session language for the message body (e.g. 'es'). Optional; omitted or unrecognised sends English.

returns.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest (64 chars) of the 6-digit OTP. On the test-number path (to normalizes to 0000000000 or +10000000000) it is the hash of the fixed code '123456'; otherwise the hash of the freshly generated code that was texted. The same value is also written to container.otpHash (with container.otpTimestamp). The plaintext code is never returned.

name: Send Email OTP
description: Send OTP code via email for authentication

to.description: Email address to send OTP to

container.description: Session cargo container for OTP storage

language.description: Session language for the message body (e.g. 'es'). Optional; omitted or unrecognised sends English.

additional.description: A second code beside the one already sent (the caller cannot find the texted code): stored as container.otpAltHash, so the first code stays valid. Omitted or false: the new code replaces every pending one.

anyOf.description: Test-account path only (to, lower-cased, === 'test@instantaiguru.com'): hex SHA-256 of the fixed code '123456', also stored in container.otpHash.

Real path: the function falls off the end of the try block with no return statement, so it resolves to undefined. JSON Schema cannot express undefined; `not: {}` marks 'no JSON value'. A consumer must treat the result as absent.

returns.description: string (test account) or undefined (every real send). Never an object.

name: Send WhatsApp Invite
description: Text the caller a wa.me link so they can finish authenticating on WhatsApp. Returns true only if a text was actually sent.

to.description: Caller mobile that already received the OTP text

inviteText.description: Invite wording from global_whatsapp_invite / _es. EMPTY MEANS THE FEATURE IS OFF for this tenant - there is no separate boolean.

language.description: Session language, for logging and future wording

container.description: Session cargo. Used ONLY for the once-per-call latch (container.whatsappInvited); the RESULT comes back as the return value.

returns.description: true only when the invite SMS was handed to Twilio (sendTwilioSMS resolved). false on every skip and on every error — the function never throws (catch at 12224 returns false). Skip reasons returning false: container.whatsappInvited already set; inviteText empty/whitespace (feature off); missing from/to; tenant config has no 'config.wa-*' alias; the alias config has no usable phone_number digits; any exception (S3 load, sendTwilioSMS failure incl. out-of-region / non-SMS line).

name: Validate OTP
description: Validate OTP code entered by user

container.description: Session cargo container for OTP storage

returns.description: true when sha256(otp.toString()) equals container.otpHash and the code is at most 10 minutes old (then otpHash/otpTimestamp are cleared and container.otpVerified = true, container.otpVerifiedAt set). false when no code is stored, when it expired (container cleared, otpVerified = false), or on a hash mismatch (container untouched, so the same code may be retried).

name: Set User Name
description: Name the person in the conversation, e.g. the account holder's first name once a lookup found the account. From the next reply on, every message addresses them by it (greetings, apologies, the guru), on every channel, and the name is returned to the caller in context.display_name; a name a flow set outranks whatever the channel re-sends. An empty name clears it: the person is then addressed without one.

name.description: The name to address the person by (a first name), or empty for none

returns.description: The name as stored, trimmed; '' when none. Also sets container.displayName and container.displayNameSetBy = 'flow'.

name: Switch to SMS
description: Switch communication to SMS and send confirmation message

userTurn.description: The user side of the switch as the text thread records it ('Switch to text' / 'Cambiar a texto'); written with the message as one history pair.

returns.description: Always the literal true: the only non-throwing path is `return true` after the chat context is re-saved under <toNumber>-<dbPrefix> with a fresh engine session carrying the old cargo, and the SMS is sent. Every failure (ChatContextManager.load, initSession, save, sendTwilioSMS) is rethrown.

The `status` field of the Twilio Message resource returned by twilioClient.messages.create() for the LAST part sent (reply is split by splitSmsParts; parts are sent sequentially). Value comes from the Twilio API, not from code literals — typically 'queued' (or 'accepted' when sending via a Messaging Service). Not enumerated because the code sets it only from the upstream response.

name: Get Live Connect Link
description: Return the tenant's Live Connect guest link when Live Connect is enabled and an agent is online or reachable; '' otherwise. Never throws.

container.description: Session cargo; annotated with liveConnectOffered when a link is returned.

returns.description: The guest link ({url}/?ref=<dbPrefix>), or '' when Live Connect is off, no agent is reachable, or the presence check fails.

name: Geocode Zip
description: Looks up the city and state for a 5-digit US zip code via Google Geocoding, so address collection can skip the city and state prompts.

address.description: Not used for a zip lookup

name: Geocode Street
description: Looks up a spoken or typed street address inside a known US zip code via Google Geocoding, so address collection can replace what the caller said with Google's normalized street when there is a precise match.

address.description: Street address as given by the caller, e.g. 1605 west olimpic blvd

name: Get WhatsApp Link
description: The tenant's WhatsApp chat link (https://wa.me/<digits>). By default (an invitation) only when all three hold: a WhatsApp channel, its admin switch 'Invite callers to switch to WhatsApp' (inviteCallers), and Meta's APPROVED invite template. With notTemplateInvite (a message we write ourselves, not the invite template): whenever the tenant has a WhatsApp channel with a number. '' otherwise.

notTemplateInvite.description: True for a link inside our own message (not the invite template): only the channel and its number are required

returns.description: https://wa.me/<digits>, or '' unless the tenant's WhatsApp channel invites callers with an approved template

name: Send Email
description: Send a plain-text email to a customer (the host's sendEmail: SES, the platform's sender address; an address that cannot receive mail is refused). For a message the flow wrote itself, e.g. a receipt; never a code (send-email-otp).

cc.description: A copy address, or empty for none. Listed in required only so jsfe passes the arguments in sendEmail's order (to, cc, subject, body): jsfe orders local arguments by `required`, then the optional ones.
